style: Quiet documentary photography for a physician-led medical staffing company on the Georgia coast. Photorealistic, natural light, shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm or 50mm lens, real materials and real places, nothing staged or glossy. Colour grade: deep blue-green shadows (#0C2A33 family), cool pale grey-green highlights (#F3F6F5), a restrained touch of clear cyan (#00C4E3) only where a real light source or object would carry it. No recognisable faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signage, no screens showing content, no watermarks, no illustration, no CGI look.

images.name: corridor
images.alt: An empty hospital corridor in early morning light
images.prompt: A long, clean, empty hospital corridor early in the morning, daylight entering from a window at the far end and reflecting softly on the floor, handrails along one wall, a parked equipment cart in soft focus, calm and orderly, deep blue-green shadows, viewed at eye level with strong one-point perspective.

images.name: badge-hands
images.alt: A clinician's hands clipping an ID badge to a scrub top, a stethoscope around the neck
images.prompt: Close crop of a clinician's hands clipping a blank plain ID badge holder onto the pocket of dark teal scrubs, a stethoscope resting around the neck, soft window light from the side, the frame cuts off below the chin so no face is visible, the badge is completely blank with no writing or photo.

images.name: schedule-board
images.alt: A wall-mounted magnetic planning board with blank coloured cards arranged in a grid
images.prompt: A wall-mounted magnetic planning board in a hospital staff room, a neat grid of blank coloured magnetic cards in pale grey, teal and one clear cyan, absolutely no writing on any card or on the board, a marker tray below, soft daylight from the left, slight angle, shallow depth of field.

images.name: marsh-light
images.alt: Salt marsh and a tidal creek on the Georgia coast at first light
images.prompt: Wide view of a Georgia coastal salt marsh at first light, a tidal creek winding through tall spartina grass toward a low horizon, a line of live oaks far away, thin mist, cool blue-green tones with a pale clear sky, large calm area of dark water and grass in the lower left for text to sit over.
